This criterion-relevant only transiently-distinguishes working memory from almost every other form of memory in which the contents are stable over time. Thus working memory can be distinguished easily from what has been termed reference memory (Olton, Becken, &amp; Handelmann, 1979), declarative memory (Squire &amp; Cohen, 1984), semantic memory (Tulving, 1972), procedural memory (Squire &amp; Cohen, 1984), and habit (Mishkin, Malamut, &amp; Bachevalier, 1984)-all of which have in common that their contents do not depend on current experience or where or when the information was learned.<\/jats:p>","DOI":"10.1093\/oso\/9780195077124.003.0016","type":"book-chapter","created":{"date-parts":[[2023,11,2]],"date-time":"2023-11-02T21:03:06Z","timestamp":1698958986000},"page":"285-298","source":"Crossref","is-referenced-by-count":5,"title":["Cortical Localization of Working Memory"],"prefix":"10.1093","author":[{"given":"Pa Tricia S","family":"Goldman-Rakic","sequence":"first","affiliation":[],"role":[{"role":"author","vocabulary":"crossref"}]}],"member":"286","container-title":["Brain Organization and Memory"],"original-title":[],"language":"en","link":[{"URL":"https:\/\/academic.oup.com\/book\/chapter-pdf\/52413012\/isbn-9780195077124-book-part-16.pdf","content-type":"unspecified","content-version":"vor","intended-application":"similarity-checking"}],"deposited":{"date-parts":[[2025,10,23]],"date-time":"2025-10-23T19:39:49Z","timestamp":1761248389000},"score":1,"resource":{"primary":{"URL":"https:\/\/academic.oup.com\/book\/53558\/chapter\/422114198"}},"subtitle":[],"short-title":[],"issued":{"date-parts":[[1992,6,25]]},"ISBN":["9780195077124","9780197734803"],"references-count":0,"URL":"https:\/\/doi.org\/10.1093\/oso\/9780195077124.003.0016","relation":{},"subject":[],"published":{"date-parts":[[1992,6,25]]}}}
